result.summary: Found two visual issues: a clipped restaurant name and low-contrast navigation labels.

issues.description: The inactive bottom navigation labels are light gray on white, making them difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker text color that meets contrast requirements.

issues.description: The “Tokumaru Ramen” restaurant name appears clipped at the end despite available space before the rating.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to use more horizontal space or adjust its truncation behavior.
